_comment: Machine-readable format descriptor for the packed QR payload (spec #24, sub-issue #26). Single source of truth: tools/gen_format_descriptor.py renders this into a C header consumed identically by the ROM pack adapter (src/pipeline/pack_adapter.c) and the host unpack adapter (tools/pipeline_test), so the two can never disagree on the wire layout. This 75-byte layout is the final, end-to-end shape used by build_event() (serialize/sign/pack landed in #28/#29/#30): a 1-byte format tag, the StarCapture run fields (course/act/coins/frames/nonce16/key_id), and the 64-byte Schnorr signature over the event id.
